name: Treasury Dual Approval
description: Approval-gated treasury operations for stablecoin payment and treasury transfer workflows with bounded authority and named destinations.

rules.description: Only permit approved stablecoins during the pilot.
Only permit named treasury counterparties and internal destinations.
Require two approvers for actions at or above the defined threshold.
Apply bounded per-transaction and daily treasury limits.
Escalate if an execution route diverges from the approved route or policy expectation.
